title: Growth Product Leader
description:
iFIT’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience. We develop proprietary software that learns and adjusts to the habits of each person as it delivers immersive content that guides them on their own individual fitness journey.

ABOUT THE ROLE

iFIT is building its next generation subscription product, and the Growth Product Leader owns the funnel. You are accountable for every step between a new visitor and a paying, retained member: activation, onboarding, trial to paid, free to paid, referral and viral growth, and in product save flows. You lead a small team of product managers and analysts and run the Growth lane of the single product backlog.

You report to the Head of Product and partner daily with the Chief Subscription Officer on offer economics, with Marketing on acquisition, with Retention on save flows, with Design on growth surfaces, and with Analytics, who hold the experiment gate.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • Paywall and plan surfaces. Own the paywall and plan presentation surfaces. Pricing, plans, and packaging remain with the CSO.
  • Trial to paid and free to paid. Decide the product experience that converts trials and free users to paid members. Work with the CSO, who sets offer economics and pricing, and with Retention on offer strategy.
  • Paid subscriber Conversion. Own the number of visitors, trial users, and free users who become paid subscribers. Set the targets, decide the experience from first session to checkout, and run the experiments that lift conversion.
  • Activation and onboarding. Decide the activation and onboarding experience and own onboarding conversion.
  • Referral growth. Make the final call on referral and viral growth mechanics.
  • Product led growth. Own product led acquisition strategy and the product levers behind organic and App Store growth. Marketing decides overall acquisition, paid, and brand. You decide the product experience.
  • In product save flows. Own churn related in product save flows and the lifecycle programs they feed, in partnership with the Head of Retention, who owns the retention number.
  • Growth roadmap and experimentation. Own the Growth roadmap, PRDs, and backlog lane. Run Growth A/B tests through the Analytics experiment gate, where no test ships without methodology sign off.
  • Partner driven acquisition. Own the product experience of partner driven acquisition, working with the Partner Product Leader.

HOW YOU DECIDE

  • Decides - Activation, onboarding conversion, trial to paid, free to paid, referral growth, and the Growth roadmap and PRDs, paid subscriber conversion.
  • Consulted on - Paid acquisition, Core engagement features, retention lifecycle programs, design system standards, and UX research.
  • Measured by - Analytics, which owns KPI definitions, cohorts, and LTV and CAC.
  • Does not own - Pricing and offer economics (CSO). Overall acquisition, paid, and brand (Marketing). The retention number (Retention). Engagement outcomes (Core).

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Substantial revenue and subscriber growth.
  • Efficient marketing funnel driven by the product.
  • Building the #1 app in Fitness
  • Best in class onboarding conversion, activation rate, trial and paid conversion, CAC, and save rate.
  • A steady, well run experiment cadence with documented learnings and clear readouts.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 8 or more years in product, with 3 or more years leading growth for a consumer subscription or mobile product. Senior Director candidates bring 12 or more years and experience leading multiple teams.
  • Proven record of moving funnel metrics through experimentation: onboarding, paywall, trial, and conversion.
  • Strong command of subscription metrics: LTV, CAC, cohort retention, and conversion funnels.
  • Experience managing and developing product managers and working closely with analysts.
  • Skill working across Marketing, Design, Engineering, and Retention without owning their budgets or roadmaps.
  • Direct communication and a bias for shipping, measuring, and iterating.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in fitness, health, wellness, or content driven consumer products.
  • Experience with AI driven personalization in onboarding or conversion.
  • Experience with referral programs, partner distribution, or App Store optimization.

DISCLAIMER

Compensation may vary based on the job level, your geographic work location, position incentive plan, and exemption status.

Although we currently may consider hiring in the states listed below, not all positions are available in all locations, and work in a particular state is not guaranteed. Current list of states where iFIT may consider hiring: AK, AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, RI, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WY.

Subject to applicable state laws, your employment at iFIT is "at-will". At-will employment means that you and the company each have the right to terminate the employment relationship at any time for any cause or for no cause at all.

Pay Range:

$180,000—$200,000 USD

iFIT does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, ancestry, mental or physical disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

description:
Join the dynamic journey at Vynca, where we're passionate about transforming care for individuals with complex needs.

We’re more than just a team; we're a close-knit community. Our shared commitment to caring for each other and those we serve is what sets us apart. Guided by our unwavering core values: Excellence, Compassion, Curiosity, and Integrity, we forge paths of success together. Join us in this transformative movement where you can contribute to making a profound difference every day.

At Vynca, our mission is to provide comprehensive care for more quality days at home.

At Vynca, we're transforming care for people with serious illnesses- ensuring that individuals receive the right care, at the right time, in the setting that’s best for them. Our People team plays a key role in supporting that mission by driving a people-first, performance-focused culture across our remote, fast-growing organization.

As a Senior HR Business Partner at Vynca, you’ll play a key role in shaping a high-performing, mission-driven culture. You’ll partner with leaders across clinical operations, tech, and corporate functions to deliver strategic people solutions that drive employee engagement, retention, and growth. This is a hands-on, strategic role that blends day-to-day HR support with broader organizational impact.

The ideal candidate will have experience working in a high-growth company, especially one balancing mission and scale.

At this time we are only considering applicants in the following states with a strong preference for those CST based: Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Nevada, North Carolina, Oregon, Texas, Utah and Washington.

What You’ll Do

  • Strategic Advising: Serve as a thought partner to Vynca’s functional leaders, providing guidance on organizational design, team effectiveness, change management, and leadership development.

  • Employee Relations: Manage sensitive employee relations matters with discretion, fairness, and alignment to Vynca’s values. Coach managers through performance conversations and conflict resolution.

  • Talent Enablement: Support performance reviews, career pathing, manager capability building, and team development efforts.

  • Workforce Planning: Collaborate with leaders and Talent Acquisition on headcount planning, role clarity, and succession planning to support growth and scalability.

  • Culture & Engagement: Champion initiatives that foster inclusion, well-being, and a strong sense of purpose. Lead follow-through on engagement survey actions.

  • Compliance & Policy: Ensure policies and practices are compliant across multi-state operations, particularly in highly regulated environments (e.g., California).

  • Data-Informed Decisions: Use people analytics to inform strategy, identify trends, and develop targeted interventions.

Your experience & qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience working as a People Partner, HR Manager, HR Program Manager or similar role.

  • Experience working in a remote-first, multi-state organization.

  • Experience in healthcare, value-based care, or tech-enabled clinical services.

  • 4+ years experience supporting clinical teams.

  • Deep understanding of employment law and HR compliance in multi-state environments.

  • 4+ years experience navigating California, Colorado, Illinois, New Jersey, and Washington employment laws and regulations to support leaders with employment decisions.

  • A strong understanding of the employee lifecycle and how to tailor programs for a growing workforce - from onboarding to leadership development.

  • Skilled at building relationships, coaching leaders, navigating complex people issues, and compliance in a highly regulated or healthcare-related field.

  • Comfort using data to guide conversations, drive initiatives, and influence decisions.

  • A collaborative, coaching-oriented approach to working with people at all levels of the organization.

  • A flexible mindset and the ability to operate effectively in an environment that’s fast-paced and always evolving.

Additional Information

  • The hiring process for this role may consist of applying, followed by a phone screen, online assessment(s), interview(s), an offer, and background/reference checks.

  • Background Screening: A background check, which may include a drug test or other health screenings depending on the role, will be required prior to employment.

  • Job Description Scope: This job description is not exhaustive and may include additional activities, duties, and responsibilities not listed herein.

  • Vaccination Requirement: Employees in patient, client, or customer-facing roles must be vaccinated against influenza. Requests for religious or medical accommodations will be considered but may not always be approved.

  • Employment Eligibility: Compliance with federal law requires identity and work eligibility verification using E-Verify upon hire.

  • Equal Opportunity Employer: At Vynca Inc., we embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. We value all applicants regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, or membership in any other protected group under federal, state, or local law.

  • Environmental Conditions and Physical Requirements: Works with Vynca patients/clients remotely and/or in-person. Successfully performs the essential duties and responsibilities of the position through the use of physical activities as described below:

    • Regularly requires sitting, standing, walking, talking, use of hands, listening, and observing.

    • Regularly requires working at a computer for an entire shift (with appropriate breaks).

    • Regularly requires use of laptop and video-conferencing technology.

    • Occasionally requires reaching, stooping, bending, kneeling, and lifting items weighing 25 pounds or less.

    • Occasional travel may be required to perform job duties, attend training, or company events.

title: 消费硬件 CG 动态设计师 / CG Motion Designer – Consumer Hardware
description:
我们正在招聘一名消费硬件 CG 动态设计师，为 AI 设备制作产品发布视频、功能演示、社交短片和广告动态素材。这个岗位更重视运动设计、镜头节奏和清晰讲解产品，而不只是静帧渲染。

工作职责

• 从 CAD/STP 和静态资产建立动画友好的模型、材质与场景。

• 制作产品转台、爆炸动画、功能演示、UI 合成和 6–30 秒短视频。

• 设计镜头、节奏、转场和声音配合，让复杂功能一眼看懂。

• 为不同渠道输出横版、竖版和方形版本，并建立可复用模板。

• 与产品、品牌和增长团队快速迭代脚本、分镜和成片。

任职要求

• 提供产品动画、消费电子或 CG 广告作品集。

  • 熟练使用 Blender/C4D 与 After Effects、Premiere 或同类工具。

• 理解渲染、合成、运动曲线、色彩和交付规格。

• 能独立从不完整 brief 推进，速度快、品味好、源文件整洁。

English

We are hiring a CG Motion Designer for consumer hardware to create launch films, feature explainers, social clips, and performance-ad motion assets for AI devices.

Responsibilities

  • Turn CAD/STP and still assets into animation-ready models, materials, and scenes.
  • Create product turntables, exploded animations, feature demos, UI composites, and 6–30 second clips.
  • Design camera movement, pacing, transitions, and sound sync so product value is immediately clear.
  • Deliver horizontal, vertical, and square versions and maintain reusable templates and source files.

Requirements

  • A portfolio of product animation, consumer-electronics CG, or motion advertising.
  • Strong Blender or Cinema 4D skills plus After Effects, Premiere, or comparable tools.
  • Good command of rendering, compositing, motion curves, color, and delivery specs.
  • Fast, tasteful, independent, and comfortable working from an incomplete brief.

title: Expert Annotation Specialist
description:
About the Role

Join an expert network supporting complex data-labeling projects for advanced AI research. You will work across multiple data types, applying deep domain expertise and helping teams maintain high-quality, consistent annotations.

What You'll Do

  • Label difficult or ambiguous examples across image, video, LiDAR, point cloud, audio, text, and geospatial data.

  • Perform spatial and 3D annotation, multi-object tracking, action labeling, and sensor linking across camera, LiDAR, and radar systems.

  • Handle entity tagging, OCR correction, and transcription of challenging audio with accents or specialist vocabulary.

  • Review and correct annotation work, resolve disagreements, and maintain consistency across projects.

  • Write and refine labeling guidelines with examples for edge cases.

  • Train annotators and report agreement and error rates to project teams.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 5 years of experience in annotation, labeling, transcription, GIS, remote sensing, or equivalent domain expertise paired with hands-on annotation work.

  • Experience leading or reviewing annotation work as a QA lead, team lead, guideline owner, or adjudicator.

  • Hands-on proficiency with tools such as CVAT, Labelbox, Label Studio, Supervisely, ELAN, QGIS, or similar platforms.

  • Strong expertise in at least one area: image, video, LiDAR, point cloud, audio, text, or geospatial data.

  • Clear written communication and the ability to explain labeling decisions.

Compensation & Benefits

$40 to $75 per hour, depending on project, field, and experience. Payment is for hours worked.

Location

Fully remote.

description:
Marketing Automation Specialist

Role Overview

BlackBox Strategies is seeking a senior, execution-first operator to own outbound and lifecycle messaging across both B2B and B2C audiences.

This role is ideal for someone who:

  • Is an expert at hands-on execution

  • Can collaborate on strategy, then independently ship

  • Understands how B2B and B2C motions differ across email, CRM, and SMS

  • Works closely with a Social Media Manager to align messaging and timing

You will partner with leadership on direction and priorities, then own execution end-to-end.

About BlackBox Strategies

BlackBox Strategies is a revenue execution agency that helps businesses grow through disciplined GTM strategy, outbound execution, and lifecycle optimization. We design and operate revenue systems across email, CRM, and digital channels—bridging strategy and hands-on execution to drive measurable results for both B2B and B2C clients.

Location

Remote | Open to global candidates (U.S. business hours required)

Key Responsibilities

Cold Email & Outbound Execution

  • Build and maintain outbound lists and enrichment workflows using Clay

  • Launch, manage, and optimize cold email campaigns in Instantly

  • Own inbox health, deliverability, warm-up, and reply categorization

  • Sync replies, outcomes, and lifecycle stages into HubSpot

  • Continuously test messaging by segment, persona, and intent

Lifecycle & Marketing Email (B2B + B2C)

  • Build segmented audiences across lead, prospect, and customer stages

  • Execute nurture, re-engagement, abandoned inquiry, and expansion campaigns

  • Manage compliance, suppression logic, and list hygiene

  • Use HubSpot Marketing Hub and/or Mailchimp

SMS Marketing (Nice to Have)

  • Support compliant, high-intent SMS use cases (follow-ups, reminders, re-engagement)

  • Experience with platforms such as Twilio or similar is a strong plus

  • Coordinate SMS timing with email and social campaigns

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with the Social Media Manager to align themes, CTAs, and timing

  • Share outbound insights to inform social and content strategy

  • Partner with leadership on ICPs, testing priorities, and iteration

Requirements

  • Minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in outbound, lifecycle marketing, or RevOps-adjacent roles

  • Direct experience executing (not just overseeing) email and CRM campaigns

  • Experience supporting both B2B and B2C audiences

  • Strong understanding of deliverability, segmentation, and channel tradeoffs

  • Clear written communicator with a bias toward execution

  • Comfortable operating with high-level direction in a fast-moving environment

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation

  • Flexible, fully remote work environment

  • Opportunity to directly influence pipeline and revenue

  • Close collaboration with strategy, social, and GTM leadership

  • Exposure to modern outbound, CRM, and AI-enabled workflows

We specialize in teaching English to students aged 3 to 18 across Asia, using interactive courseware inspired by Oxford Thinkers and delivered through our self-developed online classrooms. Our unique approach ensures high-interaction, high-quality classes designed to enhance students' English proficiency.

Why Join Polly English?

Our flagship offering is one-on-one online teaching, enabling us to provide customized courses tailored to each student's needs.

  • Compensation: $16–$24 per hour.

Application Process

To apply, simply follow this link: https://teach.pollyenglish.cn/website?ch_i=94f0a475a30e4c6e8d667e5793e09991

Once submitted, kindly notify us so we can expedite your application, considering your valuable teaching experience.

To welcome our new North American teachers, we're excited to offer exclusive New Teacher Rewards of up to USD $100 for teachers who join us and start teaching between November 1 and November 30.

🌟 Core Reward Rules

All rewards are subject to the following conditions:

  • Your first class must be completed by November 30.

  • No reward will be issued if the first class is not completed or is completed after the deadline.

  • No reward will be issued for class cancellations, no-shows/absences, or leaving the first class early.

💰 PPT Slot Rewards

Option 1 — Earn $50

  • Open 10 recurring PPT slots per week for 4 consecutive weeks after joining.

  • Complete your first class.

  • Have no no-shows.

  • 🎁 Reward: USD $50

Option 2 — Earn $100

  • Open 20 recurring PPT slots per week for 4 consecutive weeks after joining.

  • Complete at least 5 classes.

  • Have no no-shows.

  • 🎁 Reward: USD $100

⏳ Please complete your application within the next 2 days to meet the high demand for bookings.

Teacher Requirements

  • Native English speaker: USA, Canada.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher.

  • Certificates: Teaching or teacher qualification certificate issued by local authorities, plus an ESL certificate.

  • Experience: Over 1 year of teaching experience in local or international schools (including overseas international school experience).

Technical Requirements

  • Software: Polly English APP.

  • Hardware: Stable internet connection and Intel Core i5 (8th Gen or above). Ensure your device passes our compatibility test.

Availability

  • Peak Hours (Singapore Time):

    • Weekdays: 5:00 PM–9:00 PM.

    • Weekends: All day.

  • Minimum Teaching Hours: 10 hours during peak times.

Given your extensive teaching background, we believe Polly English would be an excellent fit for your skills and expertise. We look forward to the possibility of you joining our team and making a meaningful impact together.

If you have any questions or need additional information, please contact us at teacherrecruitment@pollyenglish.com. 

Why Now?

High Demand: Our marketing team is actively promoting classes, and newly onboarded teachers often receive bookings within 24 hours!

Limited-Time Bonus: Earn up to $50 by completing your application and opening peak-time slots (details below).

Fast-Track Approval: Apply early to maximize visibility during our upcoming promotional campaign.

 

To apply, simply follow this link: https://teach.pollyenglish.cn/website?ch_i=94f0a475a30e4c6e8d667e5793e09991
